description: Scheduled macro events for the Event Breakout study (doc/event-breakout-strategy.md): RBI MPC decisions, US FOMC decisions, Union Budgets, 2021 onwards. Facts only; validated by tests/test_macro_events.py.

conventions.release_ist: When the decision becomes public, IST. RBI 10:00 (Governor's statement), FOMC 14:00 US Eastern (converted per date, DST-aware), Budget speech 11:00.
conventions.second_stage_ist: RBI press conference 12:00; FOMC Chair press conference 30 min after the statement; null for the Budget (the speech itself is the release).
conventions.decision.new_rate: Repo rate (RBI) or upper bound of the federal funds target range (FOMC), percent, after the decision. Checked for continuity by the test.
conventions.surprise: Only set where a cited source calls the decision a surprise; null means not yet assessed, NOT 'no surprise'.
conventions.source.quality: official = the central bank's own page (RBI Governor's Statement / Fed press release); press = news report of that decision; consolidated = a secondary rate-history table.

events.note: Unscheduled (off-cycle) meeting; release time not verified.

surprise.basis: Hold when a 25 bp hike was widely expected ('pause, not a pivot').

events.note: Full Budget after the 2024 general election (interim Budget was 2024-02-01).
Rate cut expected; market fell on the lower growth forecast (guidance surprise).

verification.rbi_mpc: 2026-11-25: every past RBI decision checked against RBI's own Governor's Statement (rbi.org.in Annualpolicy.aspx, FY2020-21..FY2026-27): date and resulting repo rate match for all 36. RBI's only other statement in the period, 2021-05-05, is a Governor's address with no rate decision.
verification.fomc: Dates and decisions cross-checked via search results against Fed press releases and minutes; federalreserve.gov itself was not reachable from the checking session.
